notes: Compound class, not one specific compound, so resolved is false. The German description title on line 52 names Benzoylcyclohexandione in the plural as the subject of the invention; identifier carries the English singular form and the German as printed is kept in aliases. is_section_product is true because the section is headed by that title and names no other compound. The German and its EN line agree here, so there is no conflict to record. Herbizide and Pflanzenwachstumsregulatoren on lines 52 and 54 and the weeds and grass weeds of line 54 are use and field-of-art terms, not compounds, so they are not extracted; the herbicide and plant growth regulator use is the basis for the active_ingredient tag.
